source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Once per battle, when either player starts a [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), pick an [objective marker](vsdata:core-rule/level-of-control) no farther than 6" from the bearer if you use this ability. Every enemy unit in range of the marker takes a [Battle-shock test](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock), excluding **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES**. Each marker is eligible for this effect only once in a turn.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

effect.recipients: enemy units in range of marker
